title: Add Claude Opus 5 and newer Copilot models
description: Stale catalog only knew Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 4.5. Replaced hardcoded mappings with runtime discovery from GET /models plus a fallback seed containing claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-opus-4.8/4.7/4.6, claude-sonnet-4.6.
close_reason: Added models-service.ts with cached GET /models discovery and rewrote model-mapper.ts to resolve names against the live catalog.

title: Implement tool calling for the agentic harness
description: tools/tool_choice were typed but never forwarded upstream, and tool_use/tool_result blocks were dropped by extractTextContent(). Claude Code could not execute any tool.
close_reason: Added services/translation/request.ts translating tools, tool_choice, tool_use -> tool_calls and tool_result -> role:tool messages with correct ordering.

title: Replace simulated streaming with real SSE
description: handleAnthropicStreaming awaited the complete upstream response then re-emitted it in 20-char chunks with a 10ms delay, preventing streamed tool arguments.
close_reason: Added StreamTranslator with content-block index tracking and an incremental SSE parse loop; tool args stream as input_json_delta.

title: Discover Copilot API host from token endpoints
description: Hardcoded api.githubcopilot.com; individual plans actually use api.individual.githubcopilot.com, returned in the token's endpoints.api field.
close_reason: Added endpoints to CopilotToken and getCopilotApiBase() with env override.

title: Send required Copilot editor headers
description: Missing Copilot-Integration-Id, X-GitHub-Api-Version, X-Initiator and Copilot-Vision-Request; Editor-Version pinned to an old build.

title: Fix unreachable auth refresh path
description: requireAuth returned 401 before the refresh branch, so expired tokens failed until the 5-minute background timer ran.
close_reason: Added ensureValidCopilotToken() and refresh-before-fail in requireAuth.

title: Accept system prompt as content block array
description: system was typed string only, but Claude Code sends an array of content blocks.
close_reason: Widened the type and added flattenSystemPrompt().

title: Harden errors, rate limits and cancellation
description: Agentic-hostile rate limits, no upstream error mapping or retry, and no abort on client disconnect.
close_reason: Raised limits and removed token caps, added status->Anthropic error mapping with backoff retry, and AbortController wiring.

title: Document architecture and model resolution
description: No docs covering the translation contract or model discovery.
close_reason: Added docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/MODELS.md; updated README.md and .env.example.

title: Fix permanent self-rate-limiting after ~300 requests
description: checkRateLimit compared a lifetime-cumulative requestCount against the per-minute limit and was never windowed or reset, and /v1/messages called trackRequest twice per request. A long Claude Code agentic session would exceed the total and then 429 every request forever.
close_reason: Replaced with a true sliding 60s window keyed on per-session request timestamps; removed the duplicate trackRequest call. Added usage-service.test.ts regression tests using a mocked clock.

title: Fix process crash from malformed count_tokens body
description: The async /v1/messages/count_tokens handler had no try/catch and did unguarded block.text.length / block.name.length access. Express 4 does not catch async rejections, and the uncaughtException handler calls process.exit, so a malformed payload terminated the gateway.
close_reason: Wrapped the handler in try/catch with null-guarded field access, hardened flattenSystemPrompt against null entries, and added a non-fatal unhandledRejection handler. Added 5 malformed-payload regression tests.

title: Emit Anthropic content blocks sequentially
description: Parallel tool calls opened overlapping content blocks (start 0, start 1, delta 0, delta 1), violating Anthropic's event flow which requires one open block at a time.
close_reason: StreamTranslator now keeps a single active tool block and buffers parallel calls, flushing each as a complete start/delta/stop envelope. Added a test asserting only one block is ever open.

title: Fix tool call index collapse and phantom blocks
description: oolCall.index ?? 0 merged distinct index-less parallel tool calls into one block, corrupting argument JSON and dropping a tool. Late fragments after a block closed allocated a new tool_use block with an empty name.
close_reason: Key tool blocks on index or id, and track closed keys so late fragments are discarded rather than creating a nameless block.

title: Stop resolving to models absent from the catalog
description: The family-alias fallback fired whenever a family had no catalog member, not only when the catalog was unavailable, returning a hardcoded ID the plan cannot reach (e.g. haiku for Claude Code background calls).
close_reason: Added isLiveCatalog(); when the catalog is live but lacks the family, fall back to the configured default model instead of guessing.

title: Negatively cache a failing model catalog
description: Failure paths returned a fallback without assigning the cache, so every request re-attempted two blocking GET /models round trips while the catalog was down.
close_reason: Failures now cache the fallback for a short TTL and set catalogIsLive=false.

title: Fix dropped tool calls from multi-choice Copilot responses
description: Verified against the live Copilot API: for Claude models the non-streaming response splits content across MULTIPLE choices entries - choices[0] carries the assistant text and choices[1] carries tool_calls. Standard OpenAI puts both in one choice. convertToAnthropicResponse only read choices[0], so it returned stop_reason 'tool_use' with no tool_use content block, which would stall Claude Code's agentic loop.
close_reason: Aggregate text and tool_calls across all choices; prefer a tool_calls finish_reason from any choice. StreamTranslator now also iterates every choice and namespaces tool keys by choice index. Added a regression test using the captured live payload. Verified end-to-end against claude-opus-5.
